headline: Zelenskyy presses Trump at UN for an energy truce; GitHub ships Copilot runtime in ~800k lines of Rust; AMD briefly clears $1T; EU–Philippines trade breakthrough.

stories.title: Zelenskyy meets Trump at UN to push an energy truce with Russia
facts: Al Jazeera/wires: Zelenskyy is due to meet Trump on the UNGA sidelines Tuesday; Kyiv is pushing for a reciprocal pause on strikes against energy infrastructure ahead of winter.
Al Jazeera/Reuters: overnight Russian missile/drone barrage killed at least three in Ukraine and left ~100,000 without power in Chernihiv; Ukraine hit Russia’s Samara region (oil hub).
Guardian: Trump has blamed Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries for diesel pain ahead of U.S. midterms; a person familiar said he wants Kyiv to stop refinery attacks as part of de-escalation.
Macron, after meeting Trump, said Paris and Washington would work on a moratorium on energy/civilian-infrastructure strikes; Zelenskyy also shopping for U.S. Patriots for winter air defence.
stories.whyItMatters: UN week turns the air war into a bargaining chip — Kyiv wants a two-way energy ceasefire before winter, while Washington wants Ukraine’s refinery campaign dialed back.

image.alt: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill three as Zelenskyy arrives for UN summit

stories.title: GitHub rewrites Copilot agent runtime in ~800k lines of Rust — with Copilot
facts: GitHub Blog (Stephen Toub, Sep 16; amplified DE today): Copilot agent runtime moved from TypeScript/Node/V8 to 100% production Rust — 832,378 LOC Rust + ~469k Rust unit tests by Aug 21.

AI agents wrote most of the code across 128 incremental PRs (~14.5 weeks) while main kept shipping (~135 releases); one engineer led with team support — estimated ~$120k token spend + ~3 weeks focused time.

Goal: embeddable C ABI / in-process SDK for six languages without spawning Node; benchmarks cite ~18× faster one-turn client lifecycle in-process and ~91% lower ten-client memory delta vs May baseline.
Golem.de picks up the migration for German readers today as a flagship “agents making rewrites affordable” story.
stories.whyItMatters: A live, continuously shipped million-line-class port is the clearest public case yet that coding agents change which rewrites get green-lit — not just how fast a human types Rust.

stories.title: AMD briefly clears $1 trillion market cap on AI rally
facts: CNBC: AMD surged ~10% Monday, hitting an intraday high around $615.52 and topping a $1T market cap for the first time; five-day streak ~+25%.
Reuters/wires: fourth U.S. chipmaker past $1T after Nvidia, Broadcom, and Micron; Nvidia still ~$5.4T.
YTD AMD ~+180%; Q2 revenue $11.54B (+50% YoY) with Data Center $6.7B (+107% YoY); Lisa Su has guided to double data-center sales in 2027.
stories.whyItMatters: The AI tape just minted another trillion-dollar chip name — even as AMD remains a distant #2 to Nvidia on accelerators.

stories.title: EU and Philippines reach “substantial agreement” on free-trade deal
facts: POLITICO/Rappler: von der Leyen said she and Marcos Jr. “just agreed” on an FTA from UNGA New York; trade chiefs call it a substantial agreement on a clear path to formal conclusion in coming months.
Sefcovic: key parameters approved politically — next step is legal text; deal would eliminate >94% of tariffs both ways (machinery, appliances, transport, agrifood).
2025 goods trade ~€17.6B; EU already has deals with Vietnam and Indonesia and is advancing Thailand/Malaysia talks as Brussels diversifies away from Trump tariffs and China export pressure.
Public-procurement chapter still sticky amid a proposed EU industry law; signing eyed for 2027 after ratification — not yet in force.
stories.whyItMatters: Another ASEAN trade beachhead for Brussels — politically announced at UNGA, still months of lawyers and ratification away from real tariff cuts.

facts.text: IranIntl/Kyodo/Reuters: Tehran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the U.S. eases military pressure and lifts its port blockade — floated via mediators ahead of UNGA.
Fortune: USTDA funds a feasibility study for a U.S.–Thailand (+SEA) subsea cable that deliberately bypasses the South China Sea; Bloomberg-cited build cost >$14B.
Guardian/NOAA: current El Niño Pacific core hit 3.05°C — above the 2015 record — months before peak; models average ~4.0°C by Nov–Dec (“Godzilla-level”).
heise: Thirty Meter Telescope won’t go to La Palma after TIO rejected Spain’s ~€1B financing package; Hawaii site still stalled.
OpenAI Status: elevated ChatGPT errors for Plus/Pro (~09:58–10:37 Berlin) — marked resolved.
Al Jazeera: G7 condemns Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and urges Iran to stop arming the group.
